releaseNotes:
🚀 OpenTV v2.4.1 (Build 48) - Full Dolby Digital & Multi-Audio Playback:
• Native External Player Bridge: Integrated Android Intent bridge with video/* MIME type to launch VLC for Android, MX Player, or Just Player with 100% hardware audio decoding
• Solved Silent VOD Audio: Solves missing sound on South Indian & Malayalam movies encoded with Dolby Digital Plus (E-AC-3 5.1), AC-3, or multi-track audio
• Movie Details "Play in External Player": One-click external launch with helpful audio codec guidance hint
• In-Player OSD Dock Button: Switch to External Player on the fly if a stream has unsupported audio
• TV Series Per-Episode VLC Launcher: Quick "🚀 VLC" button on every episode item
• Default VOD Player Preference: Choose between Built-in player or External Player as default in Settings
